mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain positive in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off behavior that reduces equity demand and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the signal's predictive accuracy drops below 55% in a 10-year backtest.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth decline (GDPC1 qoq < 0.5%) and housing starts drop (HOUST < 2000) signal consumer demand contraction, triggering equity market sell-offs that generate negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition triggers but SPX returns are positive in > 40% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a 5-year regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production decline (INDPRO < 115) signals supply chain disruption, causing negative equity market reactions that persist over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle regimes yields positive SPX returns in > 50% of cases, or the signal's predictive power vanishes during non-late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 2.0% indicates stable inflation, reducing real interest rate volatility and supporting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 60% of CPIAUCSL < 2.0% instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales decline below 350,000 (RSAFS < 350000) signals weakening consumer spending, triggering immediate equity market negative returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 350000 fails to predict negative SPX returns in > 50% of cases, or the signal's predictive accuracy falls below 55% in a 10-year test.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rise (UNRATE > 5.0%) and payroll decline (PAYEMS < 134000) signals labor market contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint condition triggers but SPX returns are positive in > 40% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is insignificant (p > 0.05) in a 5-year time-series regression.

mechanism_narrative: In housing recovery regimes, housing starts growth exceeding 5% (HOUST t-1mo vs t-2mo > 5%) signals renewed consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth > 5% in housing recovery regimes yields negative SPX returns in > 50% of cases, or the signal's predictive power is absent during non-recovery periods.
